text: Nobody is coming to save you.

Not tomorrow, not next week,
and not when the stars finally align.

The harsh truth is that
you are entirely on your own.

But instead of letting that terrify you,
let it set you free.

The moment you realize no one else
is going to build the life you want,

you stop waiting
and start grinding.

stop hoping for a rescue,
and become your own hero.
The heavy lifting is yours alone.
